angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 750,660 km at 108.44 pc = 0.09 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 9.2219 +/- 0.0107 mas (same row, RUWE 0.96): 108.44 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.079 +/- 0.027 solar radii from Mann et al. 2023, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-2010 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166..239M/abstract): 750,660 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.112 +/- 0.048 solar masses from Mann et al. 2023, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-2010 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166..239M/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5929 +/- 74 K from Mann et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-2010 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166..239M/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Mann et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-2010 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166..239M/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-2010.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.418, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2010 (pscomppars): spectral type F0, from Mann et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166..239M/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2010 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.168 dex, from Mann et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166..239M/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2010 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.11361, from Mann et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166..239M/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2010 (pscomppars): age 1.9 Gyr, from Mann et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166..239M/abstract)
